user.title: Connect CamPiX
user.description: Home Assistant can discover CamPiX on the local network. Enter the CamPiX administrator once. The password is used to create a viewer token and is not stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect CamPiX
reauth_confirm.description: The viewer token was rejected. Enter the CamPiX administrator to create a new one. Enable HTTPS when CamPiX uses secure cookies.

error.cannot_connect: CamPiX did not respond. Check the address, port, and HTTPS.
error.invalid_auth: The administrator username or password was rejected.
error.pair_failed: CamPiX accepted the password but did not keep the session. Enable HTTPS when secure cookies are on.
error.too_many_tokens: CamPiX already has eight API tokens. Revoke one, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This CamPiX service is already configured.
